text: DSH Question Index 是面向 DSH Web 的会话问题索引插件。在对话右侧提供可折叠的悬浮面板，按顺序列出当前会话中的用户问题和 steering 消息。插件会通过历史记录接口回填旧问题，并将问题按会话保存在浏览器本地缓存中。点击列表项目可滚动定位到已加载的问题；目标较旧时可逐页扩展会话窗口。适合需要快速回顾长对话、重新找到先前提问位置的 DSH Web 用户。

DSH Question Index adds a collapsible side panel to DSH Web chats. It lists questions in order, fills older entries from session history, and saves each session index in browser storage. Click a question to return to its chat position; older entries can load more of the conversation.
想在 DSH 的长会话里快速找到自己之前问过的问题。
能不能把当前聊天中的提问按先后顺序列出来？
我希望点一下问题就回到它在对话里的位置。
切换或刷新会话后，之前的问题索引还想保留。
Help me find an earlier question in a long DSH conversation.
Can I browse my prompts in order and jump back to one?
DSH Question Index 的功能「会话问题列表」：面板按对话顺序收集当前会话的 user 和 steering 文本消息，并显示编号列表。打开会话后，历史回填的条目也会合并进列表。
DSH Question Index 的功能「跳转到提问」：点击列表中的问题后，插件查找对应的对话锚点并平滑滚动定位；旧条目可逐页加载更早的会话内容再尝试定位。
DSH Question Index 的功能「历史问题回填」：当前会话变化时，插件分页读取历史记录接口中的用户消息，将较早的问题加入索引，而不必先把整段历史载入对话窗口。
DSH Question Index feature “persistent list”: questions are saved per session in browser storage and survive reloads.
我想从侧边栏回看这段会话里提过的内容。
Show my earlier questions beside the active chat.

@lijinhao315/dsh-question-index README · dsh-question-index：DSH Web 客户端插件：**提问索引（Question Index）**。在会话右侧悬浮展示「用户提过的问题」的按序列表，可收起；点击某条问题即可把会话滚动跳转到对应的提问位置。

A DSH client plugin that floats an ordered, collapsible list of the user's asked questions on the right side of the conversation, with click-to-jump into the flow.

@lijinhao315/dsh-question-index README · What it does：- A `shell.overlay` entry (root scope, floating layer) declares the
  session-level seat `question-index.panel`.
- The panel reads the current session's `chat` snapshot, walks nodes in
  `chat.order` order, keeps only `user` / `steering` question nodes, extracts
  their text blocks (`{ type: 'text' }` content) and renders an ordered list.
- Clicking an item scrolls the conversation to that question via
  `data-chat-anchor-key` inside `[data-conversation-scroll]` (same anchor
  logic as `ChatView`).
- The panel collapses to a slim right-edge strip and expands again; the
  collapse state persists across session switches.

@lijinhao315/dsh-question-index README · Features：- Ordered question list (numbered from 1) for the active session
- Click-to-jump into the conversation flow
- Collapsible floating panel anchored to the right of the conversation
- Collapse state preserved across session switches
- Empty state: "No questions yet" when the session has no user questions
- Localized (English / Simplified Chinese)
- **Auto-indexes full history**: opening a session automatically pages through
  its complete history, so old or never-visited sessions get every question in
  the index with no manual scrolling.
- **Durable local memory**: the index is persisted to localStorage, so it
  survives page reloads and reopens.

@lijinhao315/dsh-question-index README · Known limitations：- Click-to-jump requires the target row to be rendered
  (`data-chat-anchor-key` present in the DOM); unrendered rows are skipped.
- Long entries render as a single truncated line; the full text is always
  visible in the conversation body.
